headline: Growth momentum intact; outlook strengthens further

highlights: EBITDA doubled yoy, with EBITDAM expanding to 14.9% (vs 12% in 1QFY27; ~240bps above our estimate).
Management raised its FY27 revenue growth guidance to 40% (vs 30% earlier) and now expects net margin expansion of 150bps yoy (vs 75-100bps guided earlier).
Management reiterated its strong competitive moat while addressing the trust deficit in the refurbished devices market.

It expects margins to sustain, supported by a significant increase in new laptop prices (up ~80% yoy), providing headroom (~30% of new devices vs ~50% typically seen in refurbished smartphone and used cars), backed by the Electronics Bazaar brand and a 1-3Y warranty.
valuation: Target Price – 12M Sep-27 Change in TP (%) 17.2 Current Reco.
